text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The summer training camp of the Classic 
Year. It's an important event that tests 
just how much we can help a growing 
Umamusume flourish."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Inside the bus before departure—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan, Kita-chan, picked a seat yet? 
Come sit next to me!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
No, no, I'm not worthy of sitting next to 
Teio-san!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Then do you want to come sit next to me? 
I'll share lots of carrots with you!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: No! Spe-san, you also, um...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Could it be that we... did something to 
make them dislike us?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That's not it at all~! It was entirely 
one-sided on my part, or rather... Anyway, 
I'm super sorry~.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"No, um... I just kind of felt 
intimidated, so it was hard to approach 
them..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Kitasan Black still seemed bothered by 
the innate 'sparkle' we had talked about 
before.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey, Kita-san! Haven't had lunch yet?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If you haven't eaten, come on over. Let's 
chow down on some corn, cool-style!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Golshi-san, Vodka-san! Yes, I'd love to 
join you...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, she didn't seem to feel 
any awkwardness around Gold Ship, or 
Vodka, one of her seniors who was always 
striving to be cool.
choice_data_list:
Kitasan, don't you feel a wall between you 
and those two?

Kitasan, don't you feel like there's a 
wall between you and those two?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Ah, yes. Those two in 
particular...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I wonder why? I think both of them are 
quite magnificent Umamusume, though.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, damn right it's splendid. I wear a 
festival coat in my heart, after all!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Well, admirable or not, we're outlaws, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Outlaw. I felt like there was a hint 
hidden in Vodka's offhand remark.
choice_data_list: So it's a matter of atmosphere...?
I wonder if it's a matter of atmosphere...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Atmosphere...? What do you mean by that?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I explain. That Umamusume possess a 
fundamentally distinct aura.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Namely, the mainstream and the outlaw. If 
anything, Kitasan Black leans more toward 
the outlaw. If so—
choice_data_list:
Kitasan, try talking with those two a lot 
this summer.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Talk a lot...? With Golshi-san and 
Vodka-san?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nod deeply. Having guidance from a wide 
variety of experienced seniors will surely 
be wonderful for Kitasan Black as well.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, if you're fine with us, we'll take 
you on as much as you want.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Just think of it like ya got yourself a 
dependable big bro. I'll look out for ya.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Vodka-san...! Thank you so much! Yes, 
please!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, leave it to me. I'm gonna teach ya 
plenty of naughty ways to have fun this 
summer!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna do it!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"No, Gold Ship-senpai's stuff is a hard 
no. It's not just 'mischief,' she does 
legit dangerous crap..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the help of various other Umamusume, 
I want to find a way this summer to wipe 
away Kitasan Black's lingering sense of 
inferiority.
